title: Ex-DPWH Usec Bernardo to testify in Zaldy Co's graft case

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State witness and former Department of Public Works and Highways undersecretary Roberto Bernardo is set to testify before the Sandiganbayan against former Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Zaldy Co and his co-accused in a graft case involving an alleged substandard road dike project in Oriental Mindoro. Assistant Special Prosecutor Peter Jedd Boco told the court they will present Bernardo at the next trial on October 7. Wednesday’s trial saw the testimony of Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon, who inspected the assailed project in September last year.
